Mz B v BetaCorp plc — Reserved Judgment

Case number
8000123/2023
Decision date
21 September 2023
Jurisdiction code
Unfair Dismissal
Country
Scotland
Decision
Partial success: claim partially succeeded on the unfair-dismissal head.

Reasons

The respondent identified a potentially fair reason for dismissal (capability) under section 98(2) ERA 1996. However we find the investigation and capability hearing process did not fall within the band of reasonable responses for an employer of this size. A contributory-fault deduction of 10% is applied.

The tribunal in Glasgow heard the matter over two days in August 2023. Reinstatement was sought by the claimant but not granted.
